entities.name: St. Anthony of Padua Church, Saül
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Anthony of Padua Church is the name given to Catholic church located in Saül, in French Guiana, a dependent territory of France in northern South America. The building has been listed as a historic monument since 1993.
